brief:
A 2021 case documented by Middle East Eye shows Israeli police arrested a Palestinian man identified as R, who signed a confession for a crime he did not commit after enduring multiple rounds of torture during interrogation.

The report details how abusive interrogation methods are used systematically to coerce Palestinians into confessions, raising concerns about the reliability of statements obtained under such conditions and their use in legal proceedings against detainees.
dek: Tortured into confessing: Report exposes abusive Israeli interrogation of Palestinians In 2021, Israeli police arrested a Palestinian man known as R, who after multiple rounds of torture, signed a confession document for a crime he did not commit.
title: Israeli interrogation practices extract false confessions from Palestinians
